defaults.json: one output.schema.json envelope on stdout; no prose or terminal control
defaults.cancellation: first SIGINT cancels the current operation; terminal state is restored

commands.name: env unset

commands.name: env init
commands.mutation: create the first root-signed ENV authority, local manager keys, and offline recovery recipient
commands.confirmation: absolute new recovery-output file is required; the exact file is read back and confirmed before authority activation
commands.retry: resume the exact persisted enrollment and transition; never regenerate an activated authority or replay an accepted proof
commands.idempotency: enrollment operation_id, signed authority operation_id, and exact persisted bytes
commands.stdout: public enrollment, confirmed recovery-file path, and authority metadata only

commands.name: env enroll
commands.mutation: request authorization for this CLI's dedicated signing and recipient keys
commands.confirmation: independent safety-code approval by a trusted root-bearing manager
commands.retry: reuse the locally persisted enrollment request until expiry
commands.idempotency: request ID plus canonical enrollment bytes
commands.stdout: request ID, expiry, and public safety code only

commands.name: env enrollment cancel
commands.mutation: erase this CLI's pending public ENV enrollment journal without changing authority or encrypted values
commands.confirmation: --yes required and no authority transition may depend on the enrollment

commands.name: env pending
commands.mutation: none
commands.retry: safe read followed by local certificate, signature, and safety-code verification

commands.name: env approve
commands.mutation: root-authorize one verified ENV key binding and atomically rewrap every required scope
commands.confirmation: exact independently verified safety code is required
commands.retry: resume only the exact persisted transition bytes
commands.idempotency: operation_id plus signed authority and scope envelopes

commands.name: env revoke-host
commands.mutation: remove one host recipient and rotate every scope key it could decrypt
commands.confirmation: --yes required after resolving the exact host
commands.retry: resume only the exact persisted transition bytes
commands.idempotency: operation_id plus signed authority and scope envelopes
commands.stdout: public authority metadata and past-disclosure warning

commands.name: env revoke-manager
commands.mutation: remove one explicitly typed CLI or browser manager and rotate every scope key it could decrypt
commands.retry: resume only the exact persisted transition bytes
commands.idempotency: operation_id plus signed authority and scope envelopes
commands.stdout: public authority metadata and past-disclosure warning

commands.name: env rotate
commands.mutation: rotate and locally re-encrypt one scope with a fresh random key
commands.retry: resume only the exact persisted transition bytes
commands.idempotency: operation_id plus signed authority and scope envelope
commands.stdout: public authority and scope metadata only

commands.name: env abort
commands.mutation: root-authorize aborting an incomplete atomic ENV transition

commands.name: env resume
commands.mutation: resume the exact locally persisted opaque authority transition
commands.confirmation: none; no new cryptographic material is generated
commands.idempotency: persisted operation_id and exact signed bytes
commands.stdout: public active transition and authority metadata only

commands.name: env recovery confirm
commands.mutation: confirm durable offline storage of the initial ENV recovery key and erase its online copy
commands.confirmation: exact owner-only recovery-key file is required

commands.name: env recovery recover
commands.mutation: temporarily import offline recovery, authorize a fresh manager, replace recovery, and atomically rotate every scope key
commands.confirmation: a distinct absolute old key is required when starting and the exact absolute replacement file is always required
commands.retry: rediscover secure-store preparation and resume exact persisted ciphertext transition; old key path may be omitted only after preparation
commands.idempotency: deterministic local handles plus signed transition operation_id
commands.stdout: replacement path, public authority metadata, rotation result, and past-disclosure warning only

commands.name: env recovery cancel
commands.mutation: erase a pending local recovery import and replacement from OS-secure storage without changing server state or offline files
commands.confirmation: --yes required and no authority transition may depend on the preparation

commands.name: env reset
commands.mutation: root-authorize one atomic total-key-loss replacement that retains hosts, removes every old manager and recovery binding, and resets every frozen scope to empty
commands.tty: no; prints the complete inventory before accepting confirmation
commands.confirmation: fresh recovery output must be written and read back before any network transition; exact `RESET ENV <account_id>` is required or must be supplied as --confirm-reset
commands.retry: resume only the exact persisted root-signed authority and empty reset manifests; inventory or CAS drift fails closed
commands.idempotency: deterministic local preparation handle plus persisted transition operation_id and exact signed bytes
commands.stdout: warning, every frozen scope and public variable name, fresh recovery path, and public active authority metadata only

commands.name: env reset cancel
commands.mutation: erase an uncommitted local total-key-loss reset preparation without changing authority or encrypted values
commands.confirmation: exact `CANCEL ENV RESET <account_id>` is required; --yes is not accepted
commands.retry: idempotent local cleanup; an active server transition must be root-aborted first

commands.name: connect
